user_signal.goal_or_constraint: Reflection/critique, learning/evolution, repair, propagation and anti-pollution should operate as one autonomous self-maintenance evolution loop. Material defects should trigger system-level diagnosis and learning without waiting for the user to enumerate every follow-up, while child systems inherit the method without having their business truth overwritten.
user_signal.counterexample: The existing control plane already contained M0-M11 maintenance, proactive learning, propagation and second-order review, but operational_hygiene, evolution and propagation could still be described to the user as sibling systems. That conceptual fragmentation can encourage symptom-first repair, separate learning theater, or waiting for another user reminder instead of treating one material signal as one end-to-end maintenance/evolution instance.
user_signal.proposed_mechanism: On a material signal, step out to the parent-system objective, map authority/impact and analogous failure classes, proactively scout current external knowledge when the solution is uncertain, distill and compare mechanisms, falsify the first candidate, implement the smallest canonical-owner change, regression/eval it, step out again for a second-order system review, then propagate shared method/invariants, remove stale competing mechanisms and persist the reusable failure pattern.

falsification_checks: Verify that the accepted design does not add a new root reflection policy or permanent supervisory Agent.
Verify that healthy ordinary business turns do not inherit mandatory broad web/social/video scouting or full control-plane review.
Verify that owner-local business facts, thresholds, task state and evidence remain owner-local when the shared method propagates.
Verify that operational_hygiene and evolution remain narrow profile interfaces but coactivation is explicitly one loop rather than competing parent loops.
Verify that the loop can be triggered by assistant-detected defects, drift, routing/tool nonuse, state loss and complexity regression without a user report.
Verify that first-pass regression success is not sufficient to skip the second-order system-level challenge.

autonomous_next_steps: Persist the unified-loop contract and regression evidence in the Universal maintenance checkpoint.
Propagate the shared method through existing profile bindings without mutating child business state or leases.
Use future real owner incidents as action-level evidence that self-triggering and second-order closure actually execute, and repair owner-local drift when those signals arrive.

alternatives.rationale: The implementation already shares one ordered path; preserving sibling-system framing creates conceptual duplication and encourages handoffs between artificial subsystems.
It would add coordination cost and self-attestation risk without a distinct evidence boundary or demonstrated verification lift.
It would unnecessarily break narrow owner hook interfaces and force unrelated profile/version migrations even though the problem is composition semantics, not hook coverage.

It preserves modular owner hooks while making the real control flow explicit: one material signal, one problem/evidence chain, system-level preframe, learning as needed, repair/eval, second-order reframe, propagation/cleanup and durable pattern distillation.

architecture_payoff.current_failure_cost: Fragmented mental models encourage local symptom patches, duplicated review roles, user reminder dependence and unclear propagation boundaries.
architecture_payoff.change_cost: One compatible shared-contract hardening, one regression test and normal maintenance closure metadata; no protocol/profile bump and no child business-state rewrite.
architecture_payoff.expected_payoff: A coherent autonomous improvement process that can start from user or assistant-detected signals, learn when uncertain, avoid first-solution lock-in, clean stale mechanisms and reuse the resulting failure pattern across owners without globalizing owner business truth.
architecture_payoff.deletion_or_simplification_result: No new reflection policy or supervisor Agent. Existing profiles remain as activation/evidence slices; the parent loop is consolidated in OWNER_ADAPTER_CONTRACT and the existing maintenance/learning semantics owners.

instruction_surface.reason: The current startup/maintenance routing already loads repository maintenance authority on systemic signals. Copying this full doctrine into account/startup instructions would increase prompt bloat and create another drift surface.

propagation.mechanism: OWNER_ADAPTER_CONTRACT unified self-maintenance-evolution composition semantics through the existing operational_hygiene/evolution owner hook bindings; shared method/invariants propagate, owner-local business facts/state/evidence do not.

superseded_or_demoted_surfaces: Conceptual framing of reflection/critique, evolution and propagation as independent parent systems is superseded by one parent self-maintenance-evolution loop; the existing profile files remain active only as narrow responsibility/evidence slices.

second_order_findings: Do not turn the unified loop into mandatory broad research or full audits on every healthy business turn; signal/risk gating remains part of correctness.
Do not collapse profile modularity merely because the parent control loop is unified; modular hook boundaries still prevent business-domain coupling.
Do not propagate child business truth, thresholds or task state when propagating shared maintenance/evolution method.
Do not describe contract wiring and CI as proof that every owner has already executed an autonomous live self-improvement incident.
Do not add a supervisor Agent unless a distinct executor/trace boundary and held-out verification lift justify its coordination cost.

open_gates: real child-owner self-triggered incident/action evidence under the unified loop
owner-local action-level independent verification and live quality/outcome evidence
closure.unknown_or_open_world_boundary: Future model, tool, product, ecosystem and owner changes can expose unmodeled failure classes. The unified loop improves how such signals are handled; it cannot prove that all future defects have already been anticipated.
